mapper.sql: account_id AS id, codef_connection_id AS codefConnectionId, user_id AS userId, organization_code AS organizationCode, account_group AS accountGroup, deposit_type_code AS depositTypeCode, account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, account_no_hash AS accountNoHash, account_name AS accountName, balance, currency_code AS currencyCode, account_start_date AS accountStartDate, last_tran_date AS lastTranDate, overdraft_yn AS overdraftYn, next_payment_date AS nextPaymentDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ACCOUNT WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY account_id

SELECT account_row.account_id AS ownedAccountId, transaction_row.account_transaction_id AS transactionId, transaction_row.transaction_category AS transactionCategory, transaction_row.tran_date AS transactionDate, transaction_row.tran_time AS transactionTime, transaction_row.out_amount AS outAmount, transaction_row.in_amount AS inAmount, transaction_row.after_balance AS afterBalance, transaction_row.desc1, transaction_row.desc2, transaction_row.desc3, transaction_row.desc4 FROM ACCOUNT account_row LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row ON transaction_row.account_id = account_row.account_id WHERE account_row.account_id = #{accountId} AND account_row.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY transaction_row.tran_date, transaction_row.tran_time, transaction_row.account_transaction_id
